title: The Birth of the Renaissance (in English)
description: Considers Italian history between 1300 and 1550, a period of intense economic, cultural and political vitality known as the Renaissance. Analysis focuses on the major city states, including Venice, Florence and Milan, where these innovations took place. Topics include republican politics, humanism and the flowering of the arts.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ITAL 373, HIST 360, HSTR 337A.
